profile.headline: Lead Software Engineering Architect
profile.summary: Technical Project Lead/Lead AI Architect with 8 years of experience consulting, providing solutions, improving existing systems, creating legacy replacements, and leading cutting edge enterprise development efforts for a wide range of applications and industries with a focus on efficiency, quality, scalability, compliance, and value delivery.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Architect
positions.description:
- Providing technical expertise, design, and development to drive efficient database architecture, effective API workflows, responsive UI interfaces, and thorough unit test coverage, delivering robust cloud solutions in a high-security regulated environment. 
- Accelerate development cycles and provide leadership by taking on tough technical challenges, supporting team members, and promoting frequent communications to resolve blockers faster and meet project goals reliably. 
- Owning expertise over business use cases and user experience to drive solutions which support long-term goals, stability, and value delivery. 
- Leading development efforts, DevOps, design, and architecture for cutting edge enterprise data systems and AI integrations which are built for high stability, robust security, and accelerating real world business workflows. 
- Tech Stack: Angular, C# .NET, SQL, EF core, AWS, Git, vLLM, Python, Docker
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Unit Testing · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Angular · AWS Lambda · SQL · Confluence · Jira · Python (Programming Language) · Cloud-Native Architecture · Technical Leadership

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented core architecture, 3rd party integrations, legacy migrations, ETLs, and many new features from fruition to completion for a big-data system which orchestrates the internal and customer-facing operations of a global leader in logistics. 
- Performed database administration and frequently resolved high priority breaking issues within tight timelines, minimizing downtime and business impact. 
- Closely worked with stakeholders, business experts, and QA to ensure new design and development was scalable, robust, and effectively met the needs of the company and its customers. 
- New automated logistics workflows designed showed over 100% improvement in speed and 20% in data integrity over existing system after implementation. 
- Tech Stack: Angular, C# .NET, PostgreSQL, LINQ, AWS, Git
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Angular · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
positions.description:
- Designed new compliance database architecture and improvements for a large-scale healthcare product application serving millions of users. 
- Created an efficient language compliance pipeline for database updates, efficient SQL querying of large datasets, and a 50% improvement in query efficiency and end use case UI responsiveness over existing intended design. 
- Collaborated with Product Owners to ensure design and solutions met stringent compliance requirements. 
Tech Stack: Angular, C# .NET, T-SQL, Azure, Git
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Angular · SQL Azure · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · LINQ to SQL · .NET Core · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, and deployed an inventory, accounting, reporting, and compliance database for a high-throughput printing company. 
- Managed the entire project lifecycle, from collection of user requirements through user approval, testing, deployment, completion, and support. 
- Improved inventory management, cost, and accounting management speed by over 80%, driving improved profits and workforce efficiency. 
- Tech Stack:  C# .NET, Windows forms, SQL, EF core, Azure, Git
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · SQL · SQL Azure

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer/Database Architect
positions.description:
- Created a custom database solution utilizing for all internal operations and management of a gaming computer building startup. 
- Managed entire development and design process through consultation, requirements gathering, prototyping, development, user approval, and final deployment with support. 
- Doubled the speed and improved the accuracy of margin calculations, budgeting, inventory management, and accounting reports. 
- Tech Stack:  C# .NET, Windows forms, SQL, EF core, Azure, Git
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Project Management · Azure SQL · .NET Core · Software Consulting

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded the research and design of new systems migrating from existing legacy systems to modernized .NET core. 
- Designed an internal asset management system which allowed for responsive UI interfaces to navigate and modify a large dataset with highly efficient queries with performance over 30% faster than existing workflows. 
- Tech Stack:  C# .NET, Angular, SQL, EF core, Azure, Git
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Angular · Azure SQL
